To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the developed teleoperation system using the parallel manipulator is capable of spanning the slave workspace, with high dexterity, and good tracking, to perform the operation in a minimally invasive manner.

a workspace mapping technique is developed and implemented to span the slave manipulator workspace without annoying the operator and a PID controller is developed to control the slave robot motion to have good tracking.
the developed teleoperated endoscopy system using PHANTOM Omni and 4-DOFs parallel robot has been successfully developed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a teleoperating system for minimally invasive surgery using a parallel manipulator.
the design, control and workspace mapping of a teleoperation endoscopic surgical robot system that is used in minimally invasive surgery.
the design of a new endoscopic surgical parallel mechanism and its experimental implementation as a teleoperation slave robot.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the developed system can be used in the future for minimally invasive surgeries.

the developed teleoperated surgical system is able to provide a high dexterity workspace for the surgeon, while the mapping technique is able to span the slave robot workspace without annoying the surgeon.
the experimental implementation of the teleoperation endoscopic surgical system with the proposed control strategy and the implemented mapping technique is successful and efficient.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a teleoperated surgical robot system that can be used in endoscopic surgical operations and that the system has been tested and evaluated in a real surgical environment with good performance and results.
a teleoperated surgical system with a parallel manipulator slave is feasible and can be used for endoscopic surgeries.
we have developed a teleoperated surgical system with the PHANTOM Omni master and the endoscopic surgical manipulators as the slave.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the developed system can be used for teleoperated minimally invasive surgery with high dexterity.
a teleoperation surgical system can be implemented to perform the surgical tasks with high precision and accuracy.
a teleoperated system using a 4-DOFs parallel manipulator with a workspace mapping and a PID controller is feasible and efficient to be used in a minimally invasive surgery.
